WITH selected_keywords AS (
    SELECT k.id
    FROM keyword AS k
    WHERE k.keyword IN ('superhero', 'marvel-comics', 'based-on-comic', 'tv-special', 'fight', 'violence', 'magnet', 'web', 'claw', 'laser')
),
selected_cast AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM comp_cast_type
    WHERE kind = 'cast'
),
selected_complete AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM comp_cast_type
    WHERE kind LIKE '%complete%'
),
selected_kind AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM kind_type
    WHERE kind = 'movie'
),
selected_titles AS (
    SELECT id, title, kind_id
    FROM title
    WHERE production_year > 2000
)
SELECT MIN(chn.name) AS character_name,
       MIN(mi_idx.info) AS rating,
       MIN(t.title) AS complete_hero_movie
FROM movie_keyword AS mk
JOIN selected_keywords AS k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON mi_idx.movie_id = mk.movie_id
JOIN info_type AS it2 ON it2.id = mi_idx.info_type_id AND it2.info = 'rating'
JOIN complete_cast AS cc ON cc.movie_id = mk.movie_id
JOIN selected_cast AS cct1 ON cct1.id = cc.subject_id
JOIN selected_complete AS cct2 ON cct2.id = cc.status_id
JOIN selected_titles AS t ON t.id = mk.movie_id
JOIN selected_kind AS kt ON kt.id = t.kind_id
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.movie_id = mk.movie_id
JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
JOIN char_name AS chn ON chn.id = ci.person_role_id
  AND chn.name IS NOT NULL
  AND (chn.name LIKE '%man%' OR chn.name LIKE '%Man%')
